summary.interpretation: The q95-12 dB threshold uses a global per-channel reference to avoid each silent block self-normalizing. The off-band demodulation is only a diagnostic noise proxy at +500 Hz (5 exact cycles per frame), chosen to avoid carrier leakage from a +40 Hz demodulator offset. The 0.97 occupancy / 50 ms run criteria remain unvalidated candidates.
